title: xDrip without Play Services
body:
Hello,

i use a Android phone without Google Play Services installed as a follower.
Sending the measurements from the Master to the influydb works, but I get no readings on the follower. Shouldn't it download them from the influxdb, or does this only work via the Play Services?

comments.body:
I think that what you should do is this:
Create a nightscout site and upload data there.

Than on follower phone install nightscout client and set xdrip to receive data from it.
This should allow getting bg data to work.
I'm closing this issue because xDrip now works with microG implementation.
@malloy139 That's good to know and something to add to the feature list. Did you test it intensively?

> @malloy139 That's good to know and something to add to the feature list. Did you test it intensively?

I use it as follower since half a year now and it works well.
Can't say anything about master.
